script_text: ARIES, the cosmos just slammed the brakes — Mars is about to rewrite your week. The shift hits Thursday when the Sun opposes Saturn, forcing you to confront overcommitment. Friday Venus sextiles Saturn, softening the tension — perfect for a career negotiation that could seal a deal. Weekend Mars fires your 3rd House, making you brilliant in interviews. Friday is your power day because Venus sextiles Saturn, opening a career door. Wednesday is your worst day because Saturn squares Pluto, stirring betrayal in a partnership. Say yes to the conversation that scares you right now.
